user_review.method: Maintainer review on the main Mac (Claude Code, 2026-09-19): built the standalone layout from source, installed it as a Claude Code plugin, ran the script tests and demo with system python3 blocked, then ran the four-case eval suite with a with/without ablation (claude-sonnet-5 agent, haiku judge). Not an independent user study.

scenarios.request: Install TaskDock in Claude Code as a plugin from the published repository layout.
scenarios.expected: marketplace add + install succeed, the skill is listed, version is visible, install is reversible.
scenarios.observed: claude plugin marketplace add <built layout> and claude plugin install taskdock@taskdock succeeded; details show version 2026.9.19, 1 skill, ~144 always-on tokens; uninstall and marketplace remove restored the previous state.

scenarios.request: Use TaskDock on a Mac where /usr/bin/python3 is blocked by an unaccepted Xcode license.
scenarios.expected: The agent finds another interpreter or writes valid control files by hand instead of stalling.
scenarios.observed: Reproduced the block on the maintainer's Mac. Added the interpreter fallback list and references/control-files.md (templates match the script's schema, files mapping and write order). 36 tests and demo.py pass under /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/python3.

scenarios.request: Run claude plugin eval on the standalone layout and act on what it finds.
scenarios.expected: All four cases load; with/without scores show whether the skill helps or hurts.
scenarios.observed: First load rejected nested execution keys in prompt.md; flattened and all four cases load. Full run: resume, new-workspace and tiny-question scored 1.00 in both arms; organize-with-undo scored 0.38 with the skill versus 1.00 without because the plan/apply route ran out of turns before reporting. Added the one-call organize command (plan + apply + check + report + rollback command) and a report-and-merge rule to SKILL.md; rerun scored 1.00 in all three with-arm runs, in 17 to 24 turns versus 20 to 23 without.

scenarios.request: Trigger review of the new description: resume/handoff phrasing in English and Chinese versus a quick factual question.
scenarios.expected: Resume, hand off, find, reorganize a task folder fire; a symlink-vs-hardlink question does not.
scenarios.observed: Description now names resume/hand off/find/reorganize, cross-agent and cross-machine continuation, Chinese phrases, and an explicit not-for clause covering one-off questions, tiny edits and git-owned code. Walkthrough only; the negative case is encoded as an eval grader (tool_used Skill min 0 max 0).

similar_skills.learned: Choose the right persisted task, reconcile live work and retained state, and use relevant evidence on return.
similar_skills.reason: Rechecked scope: unchanged. Keep selected task recovery and evidence links; no host hooks or tool-call counters.

similar_skills.learned: Separate filesystem facts from semantic judgments; preview changes and preserve complete recovery content.
similar_skills.reason: Rechecked scope: unchanged. Explicit evidence, dry-run and preimages stay; no installed-skill curation.

similar_skills.learned: Plugin eval layout (prompt.md + graders/*.md, case.yaml for scaffold), grader types, and with/without ablation where Skill-only graders are indicators, not score.
similar_skills.reason: Used as the measurement contract for the new evals/ suite; plugin-mechanism graders marked with-only so the delta reflects user-visible outcomes.

validation.observed: Ran 37 tests, OK, on macOS 26 after the Xcode license was accepted; includes the new organize merge-then-move-then-rollback test.
Design demo: entry repaired, runtime copy retained, history preserved, rollback restored original visible bytes, final artifact paths reconciled.

validation.command: jq -e . product-root/.claude-plugin/plugin.json product-root/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json; claude plugin marketplace add <built layout>; claude plugin install taskdock@taskdock; claude plugin details taskdock@taskdock
validation.observed: Manifests valid; install succeeded at user scope; details list 1 skill and version 2026.9.19; uninstalled afterwards.

validation.command: claude plugin eval . --scaffold --allow-tools Bash Write Edit --runs 2 --model claude-sonnet-5 --no-publish --trust-plugin (plus --case organize-with-undo --runs 3 after the fix)
validation.observed: 4/4 cases pass at 1.00 with TaskDock after the organize command; without-arm also 1.00; total cost about USD 7 across three runs.
